text: DSH Superpowers Zh 是一组面向 DSH Web 的中文工程协作技能。插件在启动时从 skills 目录读取技能说明，并向 DSH 的 skills 服务注册头脑风暴、编写与执行计划、系统化调试、测试驱动开发、代码审查和完成前验证等八项内容。它帮助开发者先澄清需求并形成设计，再拆分实施步骤、定位问题、编写测试和检查结果。适合使用中文与 DSH 协作开发、修复问题或审查代码的用户。安装命令见 README；源码未显示需配置 API 密钥。

DSH Superpowers Zh adds eight Chinese engineering skills to DSH Web: brainstorming, planning, execution, debugging, test-driven development, code review, and verification. Use them to guide software work with DSH. The README provides installation steps; inspected source shows no API key requirement.
想先和 DSH 梳理需求、比较方案，再开始实现功能。
代码出了异常时，怎么按步骤找根因并制定修复计划？
Help me plan a multi-step coding task and verify the result before calling it complete.
DSH Superpowers Zh 的功能「设计与实现规划」：通过头脑风暴技能逐步澄清目标并形成设计，再用计划技能拆解多步骤实现任务。用户在 DSH 中触发对应技能后按说明推进。
DSH Superpowers Zh 的功能「调试与测试工作流」：提供系统化调试和测试驱动开发技能，引导开发者先调查问题或编写失败测试，再逐步修复并验证行为。用户在 DSH 中触发对应技能后按说明执行。
DSH Superpowers Zh 的 brainstorming companion 页面会从 primeradiant.com 请求品牌图片；已读代码未显示向该域名发送用户内容。

dsh-superpowers-zh README · DSH Superpowers Zh：[Superpowers-zh](https://github.com/jnMetaCode/superpowers-zh) core engineering skills packaged for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

dsh-superpowers-zh README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-superpowers-zh
```

Restart the DSH Web service after installation. The bundle registers `brainstorming`, `writing-plans`, `executing-plans`, `systematic-debugging`, `test-driven-development`, `requesting-code-review`, `receiving-code-review`, and `verification-before-completion`.

dsh-superpowers-zh README · Scope：This is a thin DSH adapter. It ships only the eight listed upstream Markdown skills and does not include Pi-specific extensions, workflow runners, credentials, or local configuration.

dsh-superpowers-zh README · Attribution and license：The skills are copied from [jnMetaCode/superpowers-zh](https://github.com/jnMetaCode/superpowers-zh), licensed under MIT. `UPSTREAM-LICENSE` preserves the upstream license text. This adapter is also MIT licensed.
